exit 0
--- stdout
Launch Liza workflows in CMUX panes
Usage:
liza launch cmux [command]
Available Commands:
adversarial-pairing Launch adversarial-pairing doer/reviewer sessions in CMUX panes
mas Launch a multi-agent role set in CMUX panes
Flags:
-h, --help help for cmux
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza launch cmux [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
